cohort: Women living with HIV (WLWH) who gave birth in Finland between 1993 and 2013 (N = 212)
finding: The majority of WLWH in Finland achieved good virological control and were able to deliver vaginally, with a low rate of perinatal HIV transmission.
mod_finding: The rate of elective cesarean section was higher in hospitals with less experience in HIV-related deliveries.
